Gianluigi Donnarumma.title: The Euro 2020 Final Shootout Save
Gianluigi Donnarumma.lesson: Stay big and wait for the kicker before you dive, so you don’t guess too early.

Thibaut Courtois.title: The Champions League Final Wall
Thibaut Courtois.event: Liverpool v Real Madrid, Champions League final
Thibaut Courtois.lesson: Stay tall and spread yourself wide so the shooter sees less of the goal.

Alisson.title: The Goalkeeper’s Winning Header
Alisson.event: West Brom v Liverpool, Premier League
Alisson.lesson: Never give up: in the last seconds even the keeper can go up and help the team.

David Raya.title: Signature: the calm reflex save
David Raya.lesson: Keep your weight on your toes so you can spring either way.

Emiliano Martínez.title: The Last-Minute World Cup Final Save
Emiliano Martínez.event: Argentina v France, World Cup final
Emiliano Martínez.lesson: Rush out and make yourself huge to close the shooter’s angle.

Diogo Costa.title: Three Shootout Saves in a Row
Diogo Costa.lesson: Watch the kicker’s hips and standing foot to guess where the ball is going.

Yassine Bounou.title: The Shootout Saves v Spain
Yassine Bounou.lesson: Stay calm and patient on the line; the pressure is on the kicker, not you.

Jan Oblak.title: Signature: the unbeatable one-on-one
Jan Oblak.lesson: Stay on your feet as long as you can so the attacker has to make the first move.

Mike Maignan.title: Signature: the flying fingertip save
Mike Maignan.lesson: Push off hard with the foot nearest the ball to dive further.

Gregor Kobel.title: Signature: the keeper who starts attacks
Gregor Kobel.lesson: After a save, look up fast and pass to a free teammate to start an attack.

Lev Yashin.title: Signature: the Black Spider in the air
Lev Yashin.lesson: Shout loud and come for the ball with confidence; your area is your home.

Gianluigi Buffon.title: The Save from Zidane’s Header
Gianluigi Buffon.event: Italy v France, World Cup final
Gianluigi Buffon.lesson: Keep your eyes on the ball right until it leaves the head or foot.

Iker Casillas.title: The Toe Save from Robben
Iker Casillas.event: Netherlands v Spain, World Cup final
Iker Casillas.lesson: In a one-on-one, stay big and use any part of your body, even your foot, to stop it.

Manuel Neuer.title: The Sweeper-Keeper v Algeria
Manuel Neuer.lesson: Read long balls early and sprint out to clear them before the striker gets there.

Oliver Kahn.title: Three Saves in a Final Shootout
Oliver Kahn.event: Bayern Munich v Valencia, Champions League final
Oliver Kahn.lesson: Believe you will save it; confident keepers make kickers nervous.

Dino Zoff.title: The Goal-Line Save v Brazil
Dino Zoff.lesson: Keep calm in the last minutes and hold on to the ball tight.

Peter Schmeichel.title: Signature: the star-jump save
Peter Schmeichel.lesson: Spread your arms and legs wide like a star to block a close-range shot.

Gordon Banks.title: The Save of the Century
Gordon Banks.lesson: Move across your goal quickly and never give up on a ball that looks like a goal.

Edwin van der Sar.title: The Shootout Save v Anelka
Edwin van der Sar.event: Manchester United v Chelsea, Champions League final
Edwin van der Sar.lesson: Keep your focus for every kick; one save can win the whole shootout.

Sepp Maier.title: Signature: the cat-like reflex save
Sepp Maier.lesson: Stay low and light on your feet so you can react like a cat.

Achraf Hakimi.title: The Panenka That Beat Spain
Achraf Hakimi.lesson: Pick your penalty before you run up and don’t change your mind.

Nuno Mendes.title: Signature: the flying left-back overlap
Nuno Mendes.lesson: Run past your winger on the outside to give them an easy pass.

Dani Carvajal.title: The Final Header from a Corner
Dani Carvajal.event: Borussia Dortmund v Real Madrid, Champions League final
Dani Carvajal.lesson: Attack the corner: run to the near post and meet the ball first.

Trent Alexander-Arnold.title: The Quick Corner v Barcelona
Trent Alexander-Arnold.event: Liverpool v Barcelona, Champions League semi-final
Trent Alexander-Arnold.lesson: Stay switched on: a quick set piece can catch sleepy defenders.

Theo Hernández.title: Signature: the run from his own box
Theo Hernández.lesson: When there is space in front of you, push the ball ahead and run into it.

Alphonso Davies.title: The Run Past Semedo
Alphonso Davies.event: Barcelona v Bayern Munich, Champions League
Alphonso Davies.lesson: Beat your defender, get to the byline, then pull it back for a teammate.

Jules Koundé.title: Signature: the recovery sprint and tackle
Jules Koundé.lesson: Never stop chasing: sprint back and tackle from the side, not from behind.

Alejandro Balde.title: Signature: the overlap down the left
Alejandro Balde.lesson: Time your run so you arrive just as your teammate is ready to pass.

Jeremie Frimpong.title: Signature: the rocket run down the right
Jeremie Frimpong.lesson: Use your speed to get beyond the defender, then look up before you cross.

Pedro Porro.title: Signature: the whipped cross from the right
Pedro Porro.lesson: Whip the cross into the space between the keeper and the defenders.

Cafu.title: Signature: the endless right-wing run
Cafu.lesson: A good full-back defends and attacks; keep running for the whole game.

Roberto Carlos.title: The Banana Free Kick v France
Roberto Carlos.event: Brazil v France, Tournoi de France
Roberto Carlos.lesson: Hit across the ball with the outside of your foot to make it swerve.

Paolo Maldini.title: Signature: the perfect clean tackle
Paolo Maldini.lesson: Wait for the right moment, then win the ball cleanly without diving in.

Philipp Lahm.title: The World Cup Opening Curler
Philipp Lahm.event: Germany v Costa Rica, World Cup
Philipp Lahm.lesson: Cut inside onto your stronger foot and curl it into the far corner.

Javier Zanetti.title: Signature: win it and carry it forward
Javier Zanetti.lesson: After you win the ball, run forward with it to start the attack.

Dani Alves.title: Signature: the overlap with Messi
Dani Alves.lesson: Pass and keep running; the return pass will find you in space.

Carlos Alberto.title: The Perfect Team Goal
Carlos Alberto.event: Brazil v Italy, World Cup final
Carlos Alberto.lesson: Run into space and hit it first time when the pass is rolled into your path.

Ashley Cole.title: Signature: shutting down the best winger
Ashley Cole.lesson: Stay close, stay on your feet and show the winger down the line.

Nílton Santos.title: Signature: the full-back who attacks
Nílton Santos.lesson: Defenders can attack too: bring the ball forward when there is space.

Gary Neville.title: Signature: the overlap in the FA Cup final
Gary Neville.lesson: When your winger cuts inside, sprint round the outside: give them a pass option on the outside so they have a choice.

Virgil van Dijk.title: Signature: winning every header in the box
Virgil van Dijk.lesson: Time your jump and meet the ball at its highest point.

Rúben Dias.title: Signature: the brave block
Rúben Dias.lesson: Get your body in the way of the shot and keep your arms behind you.

Antonio Rüdiger.title: Signature: the never-give-up tackle
Antonio Rüdiger.lesson: Chase every ball like it matters; hard work wins it back.

William Saliba.title: Signature: the calm recovery tackle
William Saliba.lesson: Use your speed to get goal-side first, then take the ball calmly.

Gabriel Magalhães.title: Signature: the corner-kick header
Gabriel Magalhães.lesson: Start your run late and attack the ball, don’t wait for it.

Alessandro Bastoni.title: Signature: the centre-back who joins the attack
Alessandro Bastoni.lesson: When the space opens, a defender can step up and join the attack.

Marquinhos.title: Signature: read the pass, steal the ball
Marquinhos.lesson: Watch the passer’s eyes and step in front of the striker to steal it.

Pau Cubarsí.title: Signature: the line-breaking pass
Pau Cubarsí.lesson: Look forward first: a pass through the lines skips lots of defenders.

Cristian Romero.title: Signature: the fearless slide tackle
Cristian Romero.lesson: Slide only when you are sure you can reach the ball first.

Ibrahima Konaté.title: Signature: the powerful headed clearance
Ibrahima Konaté.lesson: Head the ball high and wide, away from danger.

Franz Beckenbauer.title: Signature: the libero bringing it out
Franz Beckenbauer.lesson: After winning the ball, lift your head and carry it into midfield.

Franco Baresi.title: Signature: the perfect interception
Franco Baresi.lesson: Guess where the pass is going and get there first.

Fabio Cannavaro.title: Signature: out-jumping taller strikers
Fabio Cannavaro.lesson: Timing beats height: jump early and use your arms for balance.

Alessandro Nesta.title: Signature: the elegant slide tackle
Alessandro Nesta.lesson: Slide with your leg low and take the ball, not the player.

Sergio Ramos.title: The 93rd-Minute Final Header
Sergio Ramos.event: Real Madrid v Atlético Madrid, Champions League final
Sergio Ramos.lesson: Keep believing until the final whistle; one header can change everything.

Bobby Moore.title: The Perfect Tackle on Jairzinho
Bobby Moore.lesson: Be patient: wait for the attacker to show you the ball, then take it.

Carles Puyol.title: The Semi-Final Header
Carles Puyol.event: Germany v Spain, World Cup semi-final
Carles Puyol.lesson: Run at the ball with power and head it down toward the goal.

Rio Ferdinand.title: Signature: the smooth interception
Rio Ferdinand.lesson: Stay calm on the ball after you win it, then make a simple pass.

Daniel Passarella.title: Signature: the defender who scores headers
Daniel Passarella.lesson: Defenders can score too: attack set pieces with a strong header.

Pedri.title: Signature: the calm pass under pressure
Pedri.lesson: Check over your shoulder before the ball comes so you know where to pass.

Vitinha.title: Signature: keep it moving with quick passes
Vitinha.lesson: Pass and move: give it, then find a new space to get it back.

Jude Bellingham.title: The Last-Gasp Overhead Kick
Jude Bellingham.lesson: Keep trying until the very end, and be brave when the ball is in the air.

Cole Palmer.title: Signature: the ice-cold penalty
Cole Palmer.lesson: Take a deep breath, look calm and pick your spot.

Rodri.title: The Champions League Final Winner
Rodri.event: Manchester City v Inter, Champions League final
Rodri.lesson: Keep your shot low and place it in the corner instead of blasting it.

Federico Valverde.title: Signature: the long-range thunderbolt
Federico Valverde.lesson: Lock your ankle and strike through the middle of the ball.

Declan Rice.title: Two Free Kicks v Real Madrid
Declan Rice.event: Arsenal v Real Madrid, Champions League quarter-final
Declan Rice.lesson: Practise free kicks a lot: great technique comes from repetition.

Bruno Fernandes.title: Signature: the hop-skip penalty
Bruno Fernandes.lesson: Watch the keeper as you run up, then put it the other way.

Florian Wirtz.title: Signature: the clever killer pass
Florian Wirtz.lesson: Look for the run behind the defenders and pass into their path.

João Neves.title: Signature: the tireless ball-winner
João Neves.lesson: Press quickly after losing the ball; the first few seconds are best.

Zinedine Zidane.title: The Champions League Final Volley
Zinedine Zidane.event: Real Madrid v Bayer Leverkusen, Champions League final
Zinedine Zidane.lesson: Keep your eyes on the falling ball and your head over it as you strike.

Xavi Hernández.title: Signature: the metronome pass
Xavi Hernández.lesson: Keep the ball moving with short, simple passes to control the game.

Andrés Iniesta.title: The World Cup-Winning Goal
Andrés Iniesta.event: Netherlands v Spain, World Cup final
Andrés Iniesta.lesson: Stay calm in the box: control, set, then strike with your laces.

Michel Platini.title: Signature: the curled free kick
Michel Platini.lesson: Curl it over the wall by striking the side of the ball.

Andrea Pirlo.title: The Cheeky Chipped Penalty
Andrea Pirlo.lesson: Staying calm under pressure helps you make smart choices.

Steven Gerrard.title: The 30-Yard FA Cup Final Rocket
Steven Gerrard.event: Liverpool v West Ham, FA Cup final
Steven Gerrard.lesson: Never give up: one big effort in the last minute can save the game.

Paul Scholes.title: The Long-Range Winner v Barcelona
Paul Scholes.event: Manchester United v Barcelona, Champions League semi-final
Paul Scholes.lesson: Arrive late at the edge of the box, then hit it with confidence.

Lothar Matthäus.title: Signature: the box-to-box power shot
Lothar Matthäus.lesson: Help defend and attack: box-to-box players cover the whole pitch.

Frank Rijkaard.title: Signature: win it and play it forward
Frank Rijkaard.lesson: Win the ball, then pass it forward quickly before the other team is ready.

Roy Keane.title: Signature: the midfield ball-winner
Roy Keane.lesson: Be first to every loose ball, then give a simple pass to a teammate.

Lamine Yamal.title: The Euro Semi-Final Curler
Lamine Yamal.lesson: Curl the ball with the inside of your foot so it bends away from the keeper.

Vinícius Júnior.title: Signature: the lightning dribble from the left
Vinícius Júnior.lesson: Use quick feet and sudden changes of speed to get past defenders.

Mohamed Salah.title: Signature: cutting inside onto the left foot
Mohamed Salah.lesson: Cut inside onto your stronger foot and curl it into the far corner.

Raphinha.title: Signature: the early strike from the wing
Raphinha.lesson: When you have space, shoot early before the defender closes you down.

Bukayo Saka.title: Signature: the cut inside and curl
Bukayo Saka.lesson: Face up your defender, then drive inside to open up the shot.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.title: Signature: the mazy run from the left
Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.lesson: Keep the ball close with small touches so defenders can’t reach it.

Luis Díaz.title: Signature: the direct dribble at defenders
Luis Díaz.lesson: Run straight at defenders to make them back off, then burst past.

Nico Williams.title: Signature: the burst of speed on the wing
Nico Williams.lesson: Knock the ball past the defender and win the race with your speed.

Désiré Doué.title: Signature: the fearless one-on-one
Désiré Doué.lesson: Be brave: take on your defender whenever you get the chance.

Michael Olise.title: Signature: the left-footed ball from the right
Michael Olise.lesson: Use your stronger foot to curl a pass into the path of a teammate.

Garrincha.title: Signature: the feint past the full-back
Garrincha.lesson: Fake one way with your body, then go the other way fast.

George Best.title: Rounding the Keeper in the Final
George Best.event: Manchester United v Benfica, European Cup final
George Best.lesson: In a one-on-one, drop your shoulder and take the ball around the keeper.

Cristiano Ronaldo.title: The Bicycle Kick v Juventus
Cristiano Ronaldo.event: Juventus v Real Madrid, Champions League quarter-final
Cristiano Ronaldo.lesson: Hard practice and strong legs help you jump high for amazing finishes.

Lionel Messi.title: The Solo Goal v Getafe
Lionel Messi.event: Barcelona v Getafe, Copa del Rey semi-final
Lionel Messi.lesson: Keep the ball close with small touches so defenders can’t reach it.

Ronaldinho.title: The Toe-Poke Shimmy v Chelsea
Ronaldinho.lesson: A little shimmy freezes defenders; then shoot quickly before they recover.

Ryan Giggs.title: The FA Cup Semi-Final Wonder Run
Ryan Giggs.event: Arsenal v Manchester United, FA Cup semi-final replay
Ryan Giggs.lesson: Run at defenders with the ball close and keep going when you see a gap.

Stanley Matthews.title: The Matthews Final Cross
Stanley Matthews.event: Blackpool v Bolton Wanderers, FA Cup final
Stanley Matthews.lesson: Get to the byline and pull the ball back to a teammate in space.

Luís Figo.title: Signature: the byline cross from the right
Luís Figo.lesson: Beat your defender, then look up before you cross the ball.

Arjen Robben.title: The Champions League Final Winner
Arjen Robben.event: Borussia Dortmund v Bayern Munich, Champions League final
Arjen Robben.lesson: Stay calm in front of goal and slide the ball past the keeper.

Franck Ribéry.title: Signature: the dazzling dribble on the left
Franck Ribéry.lesson: Change direction quickly to leave defenders off balance.

Kylian Mbappé.title: The World Cup Final Volley
Kylian Mbappé.event: Argentina v France, World Cup final
Kylian Mbappé.lesson: Keep your eyes on the ball and strike it early, before it touches the ground.

Ousmane Dembélé.title: Signature: the two-footed dribble
Ousmane Dembélé.lesson: Practise with both feet so defenders never know which way you’ll go.

Erling Haaland.title: Signature: the first-time finish
Erling Haaland.lesson: Make your run early, then hit it first time before the keeper is set.

Harry Kane.title: Signature: dropping deep to pass
Harry Kane.lesson: A striker can drop back to get the ball and pass to runners.

Alexander Isak.title: Signature: the silky close-control finish
Alexander Isak.lesson: Stay relaxed on the ball; soft touches keep it under control.

Lautaro Martínez.title: Signature: the swivel-and-shoot finish
Lautaro Martínez.lesson: Turn quickly in the box and shoot before the defender can block.

Julián Álvarez.title: The Solo Run v Croatia
Julián Álvarez.event: Argentina v Croatia, World Cup semi-final
Julián Álvarez.lesson: Keep running with the ball even when defenders are around you.

Victor Osimhen.title: Signature: the leaping header
Victor Osimhen.lesson: Jump off one foot to go higher, and head the ball down toward goal.

Viktor Gyökeres.title: Signature: the powerful run through defenders
Viktor Gyökeres.lesson: Use your body to shield the ball as you drive toward goal.

Robert Lewandowski.title: Five Goals in Nine Minutes
Robert Lewandowski.lesson: Always be ready in the box: goals come when you keep moving into space.

Pelé.title: The World Cup Final Flick and Volley
Pelé.event: Brazil v Sweden, World Cup final
Pelé.lesson: Control the ball with your chest, then strike it before it hits the ground.

Ronaldo Nazário.title: The Solo Goal v Compostela
Ronaldo Nazário.lesson: Use speed and strength to keep going when defenders try to stop you.

Marco van Basten.title: The Euro 88 Final Volley
Marco van Basten.event: Netherlands v Soviet Union, Euro 88 final
Marco van Basten.lesson: Watch the ball all the way onto your foot and keep your body over it.

Gerd Müller.title: The World Cup Final Turn and Shot
Gerd Müller.event: West Germany v Netherlands, World Cup final
Gerd Müller.lesson: In the box, turn quickly and shoot fast; you don’t need a perfect chance.

Alfredo Di Stéfano.title: Signature: the forward who is everywhere
Alfredo Di Stéfano.lesson: Help your team all over the pitch: even strikers win the ball back.

Romário.title: Signature: the quick feint and toe-poke
Romário.lesson: A small feint in the box buys you the space to shoot.

Gabriel Batistuta.title: Signature: the thunderbolt strike
Gabriel Batistuta.lesson: Plant your standing foot beside the ball and strike through it with power.

Thierry Henry.title: The Flick-Up Volley v Man United
Thierry Henry.event: Arsenal v Manchester United, Premier League
Thierry Henry.lesson: Flick the ball up to yourself, then volley it with your eyes on the ball.

Ruud van Nistelrooy.title: Signature: the six-yard-box poacher
Ruud van Nistelrooy.lesson: Follow every shot in; rebounds often fall to the striker who keeps running.

Eusébio.title: Signature: the Black Panther’s rocket
Eusébio.lesson: Hit it with your laces and follow through toward the goal.

Bernardo Paçó.title: Signature: the futsal block save
Bernardo Paçó.lesson: In futsal, stay big and use your legs to block close shots.

Dídac Plana.title: Signature: the spectacular reflex save
Dídac Plana.lesson: Stay on your toes so you can react fast to shots from close range.

Chemi.title: Signature: the low split save
Chemi.lesson: Drop into a split to cover the low corners on quick futsal shots.

Edu.title: Signature: the quick throw to start an attack
Edu.lesson: After a save, throw it fast to a free teammate to start a counter.

Miquel Feixas.title: Signature: the one-on-one block
Miquel Feixas.lesson: Come off your line and close the angle fast when a player breaks through.

Mathi Fernández.title: Signature: the fast-reaction save
Mathi Fernández.lesson: Keep your hands ready in front of you so you can react in a flash.

Luan Muller.title: Signature: the close-range stop
Luan Muller.lesson: Stay square to the ball so shots hit your body.

Willian Dorn.title: Signature: the goleiro who plays out
Willian Dorn.lesson: A futsal keeper is a fifth outfield player: be ready to pass with your feet.

Guitta.title: Signature: the lightning-reflex save
Guitta.lesson: Watch the shooter’s foot, not their body, to react quicker.

Higuita.title: Signature: the keeper who joins the attack
Higuita.lesson: A brave keeper can dribble out and become an extra attacker.

Luis Amado.title: Signature: the rock-steady save
Luis Amado.lesson: Be in the right place early and saves become easier.

Stefano Mammarella.title: Signature: the big-tournament save
Stefano Mammarella.lesson: Talk to your defenders and keep them organised in front of you.

Paco Sedano.title: Signature: the calm penalty stopper
Paco Sedano.lesson: Stay big on the line and wait for the kicker to show you where it’s going.

Mostafa Nazari.title: Signature: the brave block
Mostafa Nazari.lesson: Be brave and get your body behind the ball.

Sergey Zuev.title: Signature: the keeper who plays like a fixo
Sergey Zuev.lesson: Use your feet to pass calmly so your team keeps the ball.

Tiago Marinho.title: Signature: the quick-reaction save
Tiago Marinho.lesson: Keep your weight forward on your toes, ready to spring.

Santiago Elías.title: Signature: the low reflex save
Santiago Elías.lesson: Get down quickly to stop low shots near your feet.

Gustavo Lobo.title: Signature: the commanding goleiro
Gustavo Lobo.lesson: Shout clear instructions so your teammates know where to be.

Antonio Pérez.title: Signature: read it, steal it, go
Antonio Pérez.lesson: As the last defender, read the pass and step in to steal it.

Tomás Paçó.title: Signature: the calm pass from the back
Tomás Paçó.lesson: Stay calm on the ball and pass to the teammate who is free.

André Coelho.title: Signature: the fixo’s long-range strike
André Coelho.lesson: Strike low and hard; in futsal a low shot is hardest to save.

Afonso Jesus.title: Signature: the last-man block
Afonso Jesus.lesson: Stay on your feet and block the shot with your body.

Ricardo Mayor.title: Signature: the interception and quick counter
Ricardo Mayor.lesson: After you win the ball, pass forward fast before they get back.

Adrián Rivera.title: Signature: the timed poke tackle
Adrián Rivera.lesson: Poke the ball away with your toe when the attacker takes a big touch.

João Victor.title: Signature: the power shot from the back
João Victor.lesson: Shoot from distance when the defenders give you space.

Souheil Mouhoudine.title: Signature: the tall fixo who steals it
Souheil Mouhoudine.lesson: Use your long legs to reach passes and win the ball back.

Mykola Mykytiuk.title: Signature: the defensive wall
Mykola Mykytiuk.lesson: Keep the attacker in front of you and don’t let them turn.

Sid Belhaj.title: Signature: the pass to the pivot
Sid Belhaj.lesson: Pass into the pivot’s feet, then move to get the ball back.

Kike Boned.title: Signature: the clever interception
Kike Boned.lesson: Think one pass ahead so you are already there when it comes.

Schumacher.title: Signature: the fixo who builds the attack
Schumacher.lesson: Keep your head up and switch play to the free side.

Gabriel.title: Signature: the strong fixo tackle
Gabriel.lesson: Get close, stay low and take the ball cleanly.

Carlos Ortiz.title: Signature: the long shot from the back
Carlos Ortiz.lesson: Keep your shot low so it can skid past the keeper.

Aicardo.title: Signature: the reader of the game
Aicardo.lesson: Watch the passer, not just the ball, to see where it’s going.

Neto.title: Signature: the hard-working last defender
Neto.lesson: Always get back behind the ball when your team loses it.

Julio García Mera.title: Signature: the step-in steal
Julio García Mera.lesson: Step in front of your attacker at the right moment to steal the pass.

Marcio Forte.title: Signature: the long pass to the pivot
Marcio Forte.lesson: A long, accurate pass to the pivot can skip the whole defence.

Sergei Sergeev.title: Signature: the calm cover defender
Sergei Sergeev.lesson: Cover your teammate’s back so nobody gets a free run at goal.

Douglas Junior.title: Signature: the fixo’s thunder shot
Douglas Junior.lesson: Hit through the middle of the ball for a straight, powerful shot.

Pany Varela.title: Signature: the ala’s 1v1 and finish
Pany Varela.lesson: In a 1v1, fake one way and go the other, then shoot fast.

Mellado.title: Signature: the sole-roll 1v1
Mellado.lesson: Roll the ball with the sole of your foot to keep it close in tight spaces.

Adolfo.title: Signature: the quick 1v1 on the wing
Adolfo.lesson: Attack your defender at speed and shoot early in futsal.

Catela.title: Signature: the ala’s overlapping run
Catela.lesson: Keep moving after you pass: futsal is all about pass and move.

Matheus Rodrigues.title: Signature: the Brazilian wing trick
Matheus Rodrigues.lesson: Tricks work best when you do them at speed and with a purpose.

Mario Rivillos.title: Signature: the curled shot from the wing
Mario Rivillos.lesson: Cut in and shoot for the far post; keepers find it hard to reach.

Sergio González.title: Signature: the tireless wing runner
Sergio González.lesson: Run into space to give your teammate an easy pass.

Luciano Gauna.title: Signature: the ala 1v1 drive
Luciano Gauna.lesson: Drive at the defender and use the sole to change direction.

Mamadou Touré.title: Signature: the powerful ala dribble
Mamadou Touré.lesson: Shield the ball with your body, then burst away.

Pauleta.title: Signature: the pass across the box
Pauleta.lesson: Pass across the box to the back post where a teammate can tap it in.

Ricardinho.title: Signature: O Mágico’s rabona trick
Ricardinho.lesson: Practise tricks until they feel easy, then use them to beat a defender.

Falcão.title: Signature: the Pelé of futsal’s dribble
Falcão.lesson: Use the sole of your foot to keep the ball close and fool defenders.

Manoel Tobias.title: Signature: the 1v1 and toe-poke finish
Manoel Tobias.lesson: A quick toe-poke shot surprises the keeper before they are ready.

Javi Rodríguez.title: Signature: the sharp ala 1v1
Javi Rodríguez.lesson: Change your speed suddenly to lose your defender.

Sergio Lozano.title: Signature: the powerful ala strike
Sergio Lozano.lesson: When you get a yard of space, shoot hard and low.

Daniel Ibañes.title: Signature: the close-control turn
Daniel Ibañes.lesson: Drag the ball back with your sole to escape a defender.

Robinho.title: Signature: the Brazilian step-over
Robinho.lesson: Step over the ball to make the defender lean the wrong way.

Alex Merlim.title: Signature: the ala’s shot from distance
Alex Merlim.lesson: Take one touch to set yourself, then shoot with confidence.

Miguelín.title: Signature: the clever wing pass
Miguelín.lesson: Look up before the ball arrives so you know your next pass.

Jordi Torras.title: Signature: the direct run from the wing
Jordi Torras.lesson: Attack the space in front of you and shoot before the block comes.

Zicky Té.title: Signature: the pivot hold-up and turn
Zicky Té.lesson: With your back to goal, hold off the defender, then spin and shoot.

Pito.title: Signature: the pivot spin and finish
Pito.lesson: Feel where the defender is, then turn the other way.

Pablo Ramírez.title: Signature: the pivot lay-off
Pablo Ramírez.lesson: Hold the ball up and lay it off for a teammate running in to shoot.

Higor.title: Signature: the strong back-to-goal turn
Higor.lesson: Use your body as a shield to protect the ball from behind.

Jesús Gordillo.title: Signature: the pivot’s first-time finish
Jesús Gordillo.lesson: Be ready at the back post to finish first time.

Danyil Abakshyn.title: Signature: the toe-poke after the turn
Danyil Abakshyn.lesson: In futsal, a quick toe-poke can beat the keeper before they are set.

Artem Fareniuk.title: Signature: the pivot who links play
Artem Fareniuk.lesson: Show for the pass, then play it back and spin away.

Ouassini Guirio.title: Signature: the hold, turn and shoot
Ouassini Guirio.lesson: Keep the ball close to your body when a defender is right behind you.

Raúl Gómez.title: Signature: the back-post tap-in
Raúl Gómez.lesson: Arrive at the back post at the same time as the ball.

Ferrão.title: Signature: the unstoppable pivot turn
Ferrão.lesson: Hold the defender off with your arm and body, then turn and finish.

Vander Carioca.title: Signature: the veteran pivot’s lay-off
Vander Carioca.lesson: Smart passing lets you play for years; let the ball do the work.

Wilde.title: Signature: the power pivot turn
Wilde.lesson: Be strong with your back to goal and don’t let the defender push you off.

Lenísio.title: Signature: the pivot’s quick finish
Lenísio.lesson: Shoot early in the box; futsal keepers have less time to react.

Konstantin Eremenko.title: Signature: the classic pivot turn
Konstantin Eremenko.lesson: Receive with your back to goal, then turn when the defender leans.

Eder Lima.title: Signature: the pivot’s thunderous shot
Eder Lima.lesson: Turn and shoot hard and low from just outside the area.

Cirilo.title: Signature: the hold-up and pass
Cirilo.lesson: Keep the ball and wait for your teammates to join the attack.

Joel Queirós.title: Signature: the pivot toe-poke finish
Joel Queirós.lesson: Use a toe-poke to shoot fast when there is no time to swing your leg.

Fernandão.title: Signature: the big pivot’s turn
Fernandão.lesson: Use your size to shield the ball, then turn and shoot.

Cardinal.title: Signature: the pivot at the back post
Cardinal.lesson: Keep moving between defenders so you are free when the pass comes.

Marc-André ter Stegen.title: Signature: passing out from the back
Marc-André ter Stegen.lesson: A keeper who can pass well is like an extra player; stay calm and find a free teammate.

Ederson.title: Signature: the long kick that starts attacks
Ederson.lesson: Look up before you kick: a long pass to a free teammate can start an attack in one touch.

Jordan Pickford.title: The Shootout Save v Colombia
Jordan Pickford.event: Colombia v England, World Cup round of 16
Jordan Pickford.lesson: Stay on your line, stay big, and push off hard toward the corner you pick.

Petr Čech.title: Saving Robben in the Final
Petr Čech.event: Bayern Munich v Chelsea, Champions League final
Petr Čech.lesson: Study the kicker, stay patient, and trust your preparation.

David Seaman.title: Signature: the safe pair of hands
David Seaman.lesson: Get your body behind the ball so that even if it slips, it doesn’t go in.

Fabien Barthez.title: Signature: the quick reflex save
Fabien Barthez.lesson: Stay on your toes before a shot so you can spring either way.

Jorge Campos.title: Signature: the rushing sweeper-keeper
Jorge Campos.lesson: Even if you’re not the tallest, quick feet and bravery help you win the ball first.

Andrew Robertson.title: Signature: the overlap and cross
Andrew Robertson.lesson: Sprint past your winger on the outside, then whip the ball in early.

Reece James.title: Signature: the curling right-wing cross
Reece James.lesson: Look up before you cross and aim for the space between the keeper and defenders.

Marcelo.title: Signature: the attacking left-back
Marcelo.lesson: A full-back can attack too: time your run when your team has the ball safely.

Lilian Thuram.title: Two Goals in a World Cup Semi
Lilian Thuram.event: France v Croatia, World Cup semi-final
Lilian Thuram.lesson: Defenders can score too: if you see space, step forward and shoot.

Patrice Evra.title: Signature: the energetic overlap
Patrice Evra.lesson: Keep running up and down the wing: your stamina wins games in the last minutes.

Giacinto Facchetti.title: Signature: the attacking full-back pioneer
Giacinto Facchetti.lesson: When your team attacks, a full-back running forward gives an extra option.

Joško Gvardiol.title: Signature: carrying the ball out of defence
Joško Gvardiol.lesson: When there’s space in front of you, a defender can dribble forward and start the attack.

Kim Min-jae.title: Signature: the interception that starts a break
Kim Min-jae.lesson: Watch the passer’s eyes and step in front of the striker to steal it.

John Terry.title: Signature: the brave block
John Terry.lesson: Stay on your feet and put your body between the ball and the goal.

Jamie Carragher.title: Signature: the last-ditch slide
Jamie Carragher.lesson: Only slide when you’re sure; timing matters more than power.

Nemanja Vidić.title: Signature: attacking the ball in the air
Nemanja Vidić.lesson: Go to meet the ball instead of waiting for it; clear it high and wide.

Gerard Piqué.title: Signature: the calm pass out of defence
Gerard Piqué.lesson: After you win the ball, take a breath and pass it to a teammate, don’t just boot it.

Thiago Silva.title: Signature: the perfectly timed interception
Thiago Silva.lesson: Good defenders read the pass early, so they don’t need to dive in.

Giorgio Chiellini.title: Signature: the fierce block tackle
Giorgio Chiellini.lesson: Defending is teamwork: talk to your partner and cover each other.

Kevin De Bruyne.title: Signature: the killer through-ball
Kevin De Bruyne.lesson: Pass into the space in front of your striker so they can run onto it.

Jamal Musiala.title: Signature: the slalom through tight spaces
Jamal Musiala.lesson: Use small, quick touches and change direction to squeeze between defenders.

Martin Ødegaard.title: Signature: the defence-splitting pass
Martin Ødegaard.lesson: Scan the pitch before you receive so you already know your next pass.

David Beckham.title: The Last-Minute Free Kick v Greece
David Beckham.event: England v Greece, World Cup qualifier
David Beckham.lesson: Hit through the side of the ball to make it curl over the wall and dip.

Frank Lampard.title: Signature: the late run and long shot
Frank Lampard.lesson: Arrive late at the edge of the box when defenders are watching the strikers.

Kaká.title: Signature: the long run through midfield
Kaká.lesson: When there’s space, push the ball ahead and sprint; defenders can’t catch a fast run.

Luka Modrić.title: Signature: the outside-of-the-foot pass
Luka Modrić.lesson: The outside of your foot can bend a pass around a defender.

Toni Kroos.title: The Last-Second Free Kick v Sweden
Toni Kroos.event: Germany v Sweden, World Cup group stage
Toni Kroos.lesson: Even from a tight angle, a curling shot aimed at the far corner can score.

Patrick Vieira.title: Signature: win it and drive forward
Patrick Vieira.lesson: Win the ball, then carry it forward quickly before the other team is organised.

Bobby Charlton.title: Signature: the thunderbolt from distance
Bobby Charlton.lesson: Practise shooting with both feet so you can shoot whichever way the ball comes.

Neymar.title: Signature: the skill that beats a defender
Neymar.lesson: Practise one trick until it’s automatic, then use it when a defender is close.

Son Heung-min.title: The 70-Metre Solo Goal v Burnley
Son Heung-min.event: Tottenham Hotspur v Burnley, Premier League
Son Heung-min.lesson: Knock the ball into space and sprint; defenders who turn late can’t catch you.

Christian Pulisic.title: Signature: attacking the defender head-on
Christian Pulisic.lesson: Run straight at defenders; they have to decide, and you get to react.

Diego Maradona.title: The Goal of the Century v England
Diego Maradona.event: Argentina v England, World Cup quarter-final
Diego Maradona.lesson: Keep the ball close and keep going: one great dribble can beat a whole team.

Johan Cruyff.title: The Cruyff Turn v Sweden
Johan Cruyff.lesson: Fake a pass or cross, then drag the ball behind your standing leg and go the other way.

Rivaldo.title: The Overhead Kick Hat-Trick
Rivaldo.lesson: Keep your eyes on the ball and land safely on your hands and back.

Hristo Stoichkov.title: Signature: the left-foot rocket
Hristo Stoichkov.lesson: Practise shooting on your strong foot until it’s powerful and accurate.

Pavel Nedvěd.title: Signature: the two-footed long shot
Pavel Nedvěd.lesson: Work on your weaker foot so you can shoot as soon as you get space.

Eden Hazard.title: The Solo Run v Arsenal
Eden Hazard.lesson: Use your body to shield the ball and keep it close when defenders push you.

Karim Benzema.title: Signature: drop, link and finish
Karim Benzema.lesson: A striker can drop deep to help build attacks, then sprint into the box to finish.

Antoine Griezmann.title: The World Cup Final Penalty
Antoine Griezmann.event: France v Croatia, World Cup final
Antoine Griezmann.lesson: Pick your spot before you run up, and don’t change your mind.

Romelu Lukaku.title: Signature: the powerful hold-up and finish
Romelu Lukaku.lesson: Use your body to hold off defenders while your teammates join the attack.

Wayne Rooney.title: The Overhead Kick v Manchester City
Wayne Rooney.event: Manchester United v Manchester City, Premier League
Wayne Rooney.lesson: Watch the ball the whole way and kick through it as you fall back.

Alan Shearer.title: Signature: the powerful finish
Alan Shearer.lesson: Strike through the middle of the ball to keep a powerful shot on target.

Didier Drogba.title: The Late Header in the Final
Didier Drogba.event: Bayern Munich v Chelsea, Champions League final
Didier Drogba.lesson: Attack the near post and meet the ball with your forehead.

Samuel Eto'o.title: Signature: the speedy run in behind
Samuel Eto'o.lesson: Time your run so you’re onside, then sprint in behind the defence.

Zlatan Ibrahimović.title: The Overhead Kick v England
Zlatan Ibrahimović.lesson: Be brave and try something creative when a normal shot isn’t possible.

Ferenc Puskás.title: Signature: the deadly left foot
Ferenc Puskás.lesson: Get the ball onto your best foot quickly, then shoot before the defender blocks.

Luis Suárez.title: Signature: the cheeky nutmeg finish
Luis Suárez.lesson: If a defender opens their legs, play the ball through them!

Zico.title: Signature: the curling free kick
Zico.lesson: Practise free kicks: aim over the wall and let the curl bring the ball down.

Aitana Bonmatí.title: Signature: the turn-and-pass in midfield
Aitana Bonmatí.lesson: Check your shoulder before the ball comes, then turn and play forward.

Alexia Putellas.title: Signature: the late run into the box
Alexia Putellas.lesson: Time your run from midfield so you arrive just as the ball does.

Mariona Caldentey.title: Signature: the clever pass in the final third
Mariona Caldentey.lesson: Look for the pass that splits two defenders before you shoot.

Patri Guijarro.title: Signature: winning it back and starting the attack
Patri Guijarro.lesson: Read the pass early, step in, then pass forward straight away.

Lindsey Heaps.title: Signature: the midfield strike from the edge
Lindsey Heaps.lesson: Keep your head over the ball and strike through the middle of it.

Hannah Hampton.title: Signature: the shoot-out save
Hannah Hampton.lesson: Stay big and patient on the line; wait for the ball before you dive.

Mary Earps.title: The Penalty Save in the World Cup Final
Mary Earps.event: Spain v England, Women's World Cup final
Mary Earps.lesson: Stay calm, watch the kicker and push off hard towards the ball.

Alyssa Naeher.title: The Penalty Save v England
Alyssa Naeher.event: England v USA, Women's World Cup semi-final
Alyssa Naeher.lesson: A penalty save can win a big game; stay still until the kicker commits.

Lucy Bronze.title: The Rocket v Norway
Lucy Bronze.event: Norway v England, Women's World Cup quarter-final
Lucy Bronze.lesson: Strike the ball first time, keeping your body over it so it stays low and fast.

Wendie Renard.title: Signature: the towering header from a corner
Wendie Renard.lesson: Attack the ball at its highest point and head it down towards goal.

Leah Williamson.title: Signature: stepping in to steal the pass
Leah Williamson.lesson: Watch the passer’s hips and step in before the ball reaches the striker.

Mapi León.title: Signature: the tackle and the long pass
Mapi León.lesson: Win the ball cleanly, then lift your head to find a teammate far away.

Caroline Graham Hansen.title: Signature: the dribble from the right wing
Caroline Graham Hansen.lesson: Slow down to tempt the defender, then burst past with a quick touch.

Salma Paralluelo.title: The Extra-Time Winner v the Netherlands
Salma Paralluelo.event: Spain v Netherlands, Women's World Cup quarter-final
Salma Paralluelo.lesson: Use your speed to get half a yard, then shoot low across the keeper.

Trinity Rodman.title: Signature: the run past the full-back
Trinity Rodman.lesson: Attack the defender at speed and be brave enough to try a trick.

Lauren James.title: Signature: the curler from the edge
Lauren James.lesson: Cut inside onto your stronger foot, then curl the ball into the far corner.

Chloe Kelly.title: The Winning Penalty in the Euro Final
Chloe Kelly.event: England v Spain, Women's Euro final
Chloe Kelly.lesson: Pick your spot before you run up, then strike it with confidence.

Clàudia Pina.title: Signature: the long-range screamer
Clàudia Pina.lesson: Lock your ankle and strike through the ball to hit it hard and true.

Sam Kerr.title: The Long-Range Goal v England
Sam Kerr.event: Australia v England, Women's World Cup semi-final
Sam Kerr.lesson: If the keeper gives you a chance, shoot early and hit the target.

Alessia Russo.title: The Header in the Euro Final
Alessia Russo.event: England v Spain, Women's Euro final
Alessia Russo.lesson: Attack the cross, keep your eyes open and head it back across the keeper.

Ewa Pajor.title: Signature: the quick finish in the box
Ewa Pajor.lesson: Be ready before the ball arrives so you can shoot with one touch.

Khadija Shaw.title: Signature: the powerful header
Khadija Shaw.lesson: Use your body to hold off the defender, then attack the ball with your forehead.

Sophia Wilson.title: Signature: the burst in behind
Sophia Wilson.lesson: Run into the space behind the defence, then finish before they catch you.

Temwa Chawinga.title: Signature: the sprint and finish
Temwa Chawinga.lesson: Use your speed to get goal-side, then pick your corner.

Ada Hegerberg.title: Signature: the striker’s run to the near post
Ada Hegerberg.lesson: Move a split second before the cross so the defender cannot follow you.

Vivianne Miedema.title: Signature: the cool finish past the keeper
Vivianne Miedema.lesson: Stay calm one-on-one; look at the keeper, then pick your finish.

Pernille Harder.title: Signature: the dribble and shot
Pernille Harder.lesson: Keep the ball close as you run, then shoot before the defender recovers.

Marta.title: The Flick-and-Spin Goal v USA
Marta.event: Brazil v USA, Women's World Cup semi-final
Marta.lesson: Be brave with the ball: a clever touch can get you past a defender.

Barbra Banda.title: Signature: the powerful finish
Barbra Banda.lesson: Hit the ball hard and low; keepers find those the hardest to stop.

Asisat Oshoala.title: Signature: the quick finish in the box
Asisat Oshoala.lesson: Stay alert in the box; the quickest striker to react often scores.

Mia Hamm.title: Signature: the dribble and shot
Mia Hamm.lesson: Run at defenders with confidence, then finish when you see the gap.

Megan Rapinoe.title: The Penalty in the World Cup Final
Megan Rapinoe.event: USA v Netherlands, Women's World Cup final
Megan Rapinoe.lesson: Decide where you will shoot before you start your run-up, and stick to it.

Abby Wambach.title: The Last-Second Header v Brazil
Abby Wambach.event: Brazil v USA, Women's World Cup quarter-final
Abby Wambach.lesson: Never stop believing: keep attacking the box until the final whistle.

Birgit Prinz.title: Signature: the powerful shot on the turn
Birgit Prinz.lesson: Shield the ball with your body, turn, then shoot with power.

Christine Sinclair.title: Signature: the striker’s finish
Christine Sinclair.lesson: Great strikers are always in the right place: watch where the ball will land.

Alex Morgan.title: The 123rd-Minute Header v Canada
Alex Morgan.lesson: Keep your energy for the end: late goals win big games.

Carli Lloyd.title: The Halfway-Line Goal in the Final
Carli Lloyd.event: USA v Japan, Women's World Cup final
Carli Lloyd.lesson: Look up! If the keeper is off her line, you can score from far away.

Hope Solo.title: The Shoot-Out Save v Brazil
Hope Solo.event: Brazil v USA, Women's World Cup quarter-final
Hope Solo.lesson: In a shoot-out one save can decide everything, so stay focused.

Nadine Angerer.title: The Penalty Save v Marta in the Final
Nadine Angerer.event: Germany v Brazil, Women's World Cup final
Nadine Angerer.lesson: Keep your weight on your toes so you can spring either way.

Formiga.title: Signature: winning it back in midfield
Formiga.lesson: Stay close to your opponent and nip in when the pass is loose.

Homare Sawa.title: The Extra-Time Flick in the Final
Homare Sawa.event: Japan v USA, Women's World Cup final
Homare Sawa.lesson: At a corner, get to the ball first; even a small flick can score.

Sun Wen.title: Signature: the clever finish
Sun Wen.lesson: Find space where the defenders are not looking, then finish quickly.

Michelle Akers.title: The Late Winner in the First Final
Michelle Akers.event: USA v Norway, Women's World Cup final
Michelle Akers.lesson: Chase every loose ball: a defender’s mistake can become your goal.

Kristine Lilly.title: The Goal-Line Header in the Final
Kristine Lilly.event: USA v China, Women's World Cup final
Kristine Lilly.lesson: Guard the post at corners; a header off the line is as good as a goal.

Lieke Martens.title: Signature: the step-over on the left wing
Lieke Martens.lesson: Sell the step-over with your shoulders, then go the other way.

Roberto Baggio.title: The Late Winner v Spain
Roberto Baggio.event: Italy v Spain, World Cup quarter-final
Roberto Baggio.lesson: Stay calm when you are through: take the keeper on and slot it in.

Francesco Totti.title: The Chipped Penalty v the Netherlands
Francesco Totti.lesson: A calm chip only works if you are brave, so practise it first.

Alessandro Del Piero.title: The Curler in Extra Time v Germany
Alessandro Del Piero.event: Germany v Italy, World Cup semi-final
Alessandro Del Piero.lesson: Open your body and curl the ball with the inside of your foot.

Dennis Bergkamp.title: The Three Touches v Argentina
Dennis Bergkamp.event: Netherlands v Argentina, World Cup quarter-final
Dennis Bergkamp.lesson: A perfect first touch sets up everything that comes next.

Raúl.title: Signature: the cool chip over the keeper
Raúl.lesson: When the keeper rushes out, a gentle chip can be the best finish.

Andriy Shevchenko.title: The Winning Penalty in the Final
Andriy Shevchenko.event: Juventus v AC Milan, Champions League final
Andriy Shevchenko.lesson: Take a deep breath, pick your spot and trust your practice.

Paolo Rossi.title: The Hat-Trick v Brazil
Paolo Rossi.event: Italy v Brazil, World Cup second round
Paolo Rossi.lesson: Be in the box when the cross comes: goals come to strikers who get there.

George Weah.title: The Length-of-the-Pitch Run v Verona
George Weah.event: AC Milan v Verona, Serie A
George Weah.lesson: Once you are running, keep the ball close and keep going.

Kenny Dalglish.title: The Chip in the European Cup Final
Kenny Dalglish.event: Liverpool v Club Brugge, European Cup final
Kenny Dalglish.lesson: Wait for the keeper to go down, then lift the ball gently over them.

Michael Laudrup.title: Signature: the no-look through ball
Michael Laudrup.lesson: Look one way and pass the other to fool the defenders.

Gheorghe Hagi.title: The Long-Range Lob v Colombia
Gheorghe Hagi.event: Romania v Colombia, World Cup group stage
Gheorghe Hagi.lesson: If the keeper is off the line, a high lob can drop in behind them.

Rui Costa.title: Signature: the perfect through ball
Rui Costa.lesson: Weight your pass so the striker can run onto it without breaking stride.

Clarence Seedorf.title: Signature: the long-range thunderbolt
Clarence Seedorf.lesson: Strike through the ball with your laces and follow through towards goal.

Claude Makélélé.title: Signature: the steal in front of the defence
Claude Makélélé.lesson: Stay between the ball and your goal, then pass simply once you win it.

Michael Owen.title: The Solo Goal v Argentina
Michael Owen.event: Argentina v England, World Cup round of 16
Michael Owen.lesson: Run straight at defenders with speed; they hate backing off.

Gary Lineker.title: Signature: the poacher’s finish in the six-yard box
Gary Lineker.lesson: Get across your defender to the near post and finish with one touch.

Moisés Caicedo.title: Signature: the steal and go
Moisés Caicedo.lesson: Watch the passer’s eyes and hips to guess the pass, then step in and steal it.

Antoine Semenyo.title: Signature: the powerful run and shot
Antoine Semenyo.lesson: Carry the ball at speed into space, then shoot before the defender recovers.

Aurélien Tchouaméni.title: Signature: the shield in front of the defence
Aurélien Tchouaméni.lesson: Stay between the ball and your goal so attackers have to go around you.

Joshua Kimmich.title: Signature: the pinpoint pass from deep
Joshua Kimmich.lesson: Look up early and aim your pass at your teammate’s front foot.

Bernardo Silva.title: Signature: the close-control wriggle
Bernardo Silva.lesson: Keep the ball glued to your foot and use your body to shield it.

Denzel Dumfries.title: Signature: the wing-back charge
Denzel Dumfries.lesson: When your team wins the ball, sprint forward on the outside to stretch the defence.

Jérémy Doku.title: Signature: the dribble at full speed
Jérémy Doku.lesson: Change pace suddenly: go slow, then explode past the defender.

Rayan Cherki.title: Signature: the two-footed playmaker
Rayan Cherki.lesson: Practise with both feet so defenders can’t guess which way you will go.

N'Golo Kanté.title: Signature: the ball-winning sprint
N'Golo Kanté.lesson: Press quickly after losing the ball: the best time to win it back is straight away.

Tijjani Reijnders.title: Signature: the late run into the box
Tijjani Reijnders.lesson: Arrive late in the box: defenders watch the strikers and forget the midfielder.

Bruno Guimarães.title: Signature: win it, then pass forward
Bruno Guimarães.lesson: After you win the ball, look forward first for a quick pass.

Frenkie de Jong.title: Signature: carrying the ball out of pressure
Frenkie de Jong.lesson: When pressed, turn away from the defender and carry the ball into open space.

Marc Cucurella.title: Signature: defend, then join the attack
Marc Cucurella.lesson: Defend first, then join the attack when your winger has the ball.

Sadio Mané.title: Signature: the quick cut and finish
Sadio Mané.lesson: Press the defender straight away: winning the ball high up leaves a short run to goal.

Martín Zubimendi.title: Signature: the calm holding midfielder
Martín Zubimendi.lesson: Stand where the forward pass has to go through you, not around you.

Enzo Fernández.title: Signature: the curler from range
Enzo Fernández.lesson: Curl the ball towards the far corner, away from the keeper’s reach.

Willian Pacho.title: Signature: the recovery sprint
Willian Pacho.lesson: Turn and sprint back goal-side before you try to win the ball.

Scott McTominay.title: Signature: the late run and finish
Scott McTominay.lesson: Time your run so you arrive in the box just as the ball does.

Ryan Gravenberch.title: Signature: steal and carry
Ryan Gravenberch.lesson: After you win the ball, carry it forward into the space in front of you.

Fermín López.title: Signature: the surprise run and shot
Fermín López.lesson: Keep running forward after you pass: the return ball can find you free.

Cody Gakpo.title: Signature: cut inside and curl
Cody Gakpo.lesson: From the left wing, cut inside onto your right foot and aim for the far corner.

João Pedro.title: Signature: the curler from the edge
João Pedro.lesson: Open your body and curl the ball so it bends away from the keeper.

Ismaïla Sarr.title: Signature: the sprint in behind
Ismaïla Sarr.lesson: Run in behind the defence the moment your teammate looks up to pass.

Rafael Leão.title: Signature: the long-stride dribble
Rafael Leão.lesson: Take long strides in open space, then short touches when defenders get close.

Alexis Mac Allister.title: Signature: setting the tempo
Alexis Mac Allister.lesson: Slow the game with safe passes, then speed it up with one quick forward pass.

Weston McKennie.title: Signature: the late header
Weston McKennie.lesson: Attack the ball in the air: jump early and hit it with your forehead.

Gabriel Martinelli.title: Signature: the press and pounce
Gabriel Martinelli.lesson: Chase every loose ball: pressing can turn a defender’s mistake into a goal.

João Cancelo.title: Signature: the full-back playmaker
João Cancelo.lesson: A full-back can step inside into midfield to add an extra passer.

Dani Olmo.title: Signature: finding the pocket of space
Dani Olmo.lesson: Stand between the other team’s midfield and defence, where nobody is marking you.

Arda Güler.title: Signature: the left-footed curler
Arda Güler.lesson: Wrap your foot around the ball to curl it into the top corner.

Marc Guéhi.title: Signature: the perfectly timed block
Marc Guéhi.lesson: Stay on your feet and block the shot with your body facing the ball.

Fabián Ruiz.title: Signature: keep it, then break the lines
Fabián Ruiz.lesson: Keep the ball moving with short passes until a gap opens for a forward pass.

Casemiro.title: Signature: the defensive midfield anchor
Casemiro.lesson: Stay in front of your defenders to block the middle of the pitch.

Mikel Merino.title: Signature: the late header
Mikel Merino.lesson: Arrive late at the back post: defenders often forget the midfielder.

Eberechi Eze.title: Signature: the silky dribble
Eberechi Eze.lesson: Drop your shoulder to fake one way, then go the other.

Kenan Yıldız.title: Signature: face up and cut inside
Kenan Yıldız.lesson: Face your defender, fake one way, and cut inside to shoot.

Raúl Jiménez.title: Signature: the striker’s header
Raúl Jiménez.lesson: Watch the ball onto your forehead and aim down towards the goal.

Gonçalo Ramos.title: Signature: the first-time finish
Gonçalo Ramos.lesson: Keep moving in the box so the defender can’t settle next to you.

Mikel Oyarzabal.title: Signature: the run across the defender
Mikel Oyarzabal.lesson: Sprint across your defender to meet a low cross first.

Marcus Thuram.title: Signature: the powerful run in behind
Marcus Thuram.lesson: Use your body to hold off the defender while you drive towards goal.

Kaoru Mitoma.title: Signature: the studied dribble
Kaoru Mitoma.lesson: Watch the defender’s hips, not their feet, to know when to go past.

Phil Foden.title: Signature: set and strike
Phil Foden.lesson: Take one touch to set the ball, then strike low before the keeper is ready.

Lisandro Martínez.title: Signature: the brave challenge
Lisandro Martínez.lesson: You don’t need to be the tallest: good timing and bravery win duels.

Bradley Barcola.title: Signature: go before they’re set
Bradley Barcola.lesson: Use your speed early: run at the defender before they get set.

Pervis Estupiñán.title: Signature: the overlap and cross
Pervis Estupiñán.lesson: Time your overlap so you arrive just as your winger is ready to pass.

Ivan Rakitić.title: The Early Goal in the Champions League Final
Ivan Rakitić.event: Juventus v Barcelona, Champions League final
Ivan Rakitić.lesson: Arrive in the box at the right moment and finish first time, before a defender can block.

Raphaël Varane.title: The World Cup Header v Uruguay
Raphaël Varane.event: Uruguay v France, World Cup quarter-final
Raphaël Varane.lesson: At a free kick, time your run and attack the ball with your forehead.

Anthony Gordon.title: Four Goals in One Night
Anthony Gordon.event: Newcastle United's 6–1 win over Qarabağ, Champions League play-offs
Anthony Gordon.lesson: Keep making runs behind the defence: one good run can turn into many goals.

Juan Román Riquelme.title: The Nutmeg on Yepes
Juan Román Riquelme.event: Boca Juniors v River Plate, Copa Libertadores quarter-final
Juan Román Riquelme.lesson: Shield the ball with your body, then slip it through the defender’s legs when they get too close.

Jay-Jay Okocha.title: Dancing Past Oliver Kahn
Jay-Jay Okocha.event: Eintracht Frankfurt v Karlsruher SC, Bundesliga
Jay-Jay Okocha.lesson: Stay calm in the box: quick changes of direction can beat defenders and even the keeper.

Endrick.title: The Teenage Winner at Wembley
Endrick.lesson: Be ready near goal: a quick first-time finish gives the keeper no time to set.

Karim Adeyemi.title: Speed Behind the Defence
Karim Adeyemi.event: How he does it · scored a hat-trick in one half v Celtic, Champions League
Karim Adeyemi.lesson: Use your speed early: attack the space behind the defence before it closes.

Pepe.title: Winning Every Header
Pepe.event: How he does it · man of the match as Portugal beat France in the Euro 2016 final
Pepe.lesson: Stay close to your striker, stay on your feet and head every cross away.

Elliot Anderson.title: Signature: win it and drive forward
Elliot Anderson.lesson: Win the ball, lift your head and carry it forward into the space in front of you.

Park Ji-sung.title: The World Cup Winner v Portugal
Park Ji-sung.event: South Korea v Portugal, World Cup
Park Ji-sung.lesson: Control the ball with your chest, then shoot before the defender can block.

Sandro Tonali.title: The Goal on His Premier League Debut
Sandro Tonali.event: Newcastle United v Aston Villa, Premier League
Sandro Tonali.lesson: Arrive late in the box: a midfielder’s run is the hardest one for defenders to follow.

Gareth Bale.title: The Overhead Kick in the Final
Gareth Bale.event: Real Madrid v Liverpool, Champions League final
Gareth Bale.lesson: Be brave when the ball is in the air and keep your eyes on it as you kick.

Ángel Di María.title: The Maracanã Chip
Ángel Di María.event: Argentina v Brazil, Copa América final
Ángel Di María.lesson: When the keeper rushes out, lift the ball gently over them.

Mesut Özil.title: The Solo Goal v Ludogorets
Mesut Özil.lesson: Stay calm in front of goal: one more touch can send the defenders sliding past.

Jordi Alba.title: The Sprint and Finish in the Euro Final
Jordi Alba.lesson: When a teammate looks up, sprint into the space behind the defence.

Javier Mascherano.title: The Tackle on Robben
Javier Mascherano.event: Netherlands v Argentina, World Cup semi-final
Javier Mascherano.lesson: Stay on your feet as long as you can, and only slide when you are sure you can reach the ball.

Carlos Tevez.title: The Olympic Final Winner
Carlos Tevez.lesson: Keep moving in the box so you are ready the moment the chance arrives.

Sergio Agüero.title: The 93:20 Title Winner
Sergio Agüero.event: Manchester City v QPR, Premier League
Sergio Agüero.lesson: Never stop believing: a quick one-two in the box can win a match in the last minute.

Mario Balotelli.title: The Thunderbolt v Germany
Mario Balotelli.lesson: Stay on the shoulder of the last defender, then strike hard the moment you break through.

Rodrigo De Paul.title: The Long Pass That Won the Copa
Rodrigo De Paul.event: Argentina v Brazil, Copa América final
Rodrigo De Paul.lesson: Look up early: one long pass over the defence can find a runner in space.

Vincent Kompany.title: The Captain’s Long-Range Title Winner
Vincent Kompany.event: Manchester City v Leicester City, Premier League
Vincent Kompany.lesson: If the defence backs off and nobody closes you down, a strong, clean strike can surprise the keeper.

Vozinha.title: Goalkeeping Masterclass
Vozinha.event: How he does it · seven saves in a 0–0 draw with Spain, World Cup group stage
Vozinha.lesson: Stay on your toes and set your feet before the shot, so you can spring either way.

Jonathan David.title: Canada’s First World Cup Hat-Trick
Jonathan David.event: Canada v Qatar, World Cup group stage
Jonathan David.lesson: Keep moving in the box and hit the ball first time, before the defender can block it.

Brahim Díaz.title: The Slalom Goal in Leipzig
Brahim Díaz.event: RB Leipzig v Real Madrid, Champions League round of 16
Brahim Díaz.lesson: Keep the ball close with small touches so you can change direction past each defender.

Leonardo Bonucci.title: The Euro Final Equaliser
Leonardo Bonucci.lesson: Follow every shot in: rebounds from corners fall to the player who keeps going.

Cesc Fàbregas.title: The Pass for the World Cup Winner
Cesc Fàbregas.event: Netherlands v Spain, World Cup final
Cesc Fàbregas.lesson: Keep your head up in extra time too: one calm pass into space can win the biggest game.

Edinson Cavani.title: The One-Two Header Against Portugal
Edinson Cavani.event: Uruguay v Portugal, World Cup round of 16
Edinson Cavani.lesson: Pass and keep running: the ball can come straight back to you in the box.

Eric Cantona.title: The Chip v Sunderland
Eric Cantona.event: Manchester United v Sunderland, Premier League
Eric Cantona.lesson: When the keeper rushes out, stay calm and lift the ball gently over them.

Thomas Müller.title: The Free Volley at the Back Post
Thomas Müller.event: Brazil v Germany, World Cup semi-final
Thomas Müller.lesson: Move away from your marker before the ball comes, so you are free when it arrives.

Olivier Giroud.title: The Scorpion Kick
Olivier Giroud.event: Arsenal v Crystal Palace, Premier League
Olivier Giroud.lesson: If the ball comes behind you, be brave and creative: keep your eye on it and try a flick.

Keylor Navas.title: The Shootout Save v Greece
Keylor Navas.event: Costa Rica v Greece, World Cup round of 16
Keylor Navas.lesson: Stay on your toes and push off hard; a strong hand can stop even a high shot.

Lúcio.title: The Captain's Header in the Final
Lúcio.event: USA v Brazil, Confederations Cup final
Lúcio.lesson: Defenders can score too: attack the corner and head the ball down hard.

Kyle Walker.title: Signature: the recovery sprint
Kyle Walker.lesson: If a winger gets past you, don't give up: sprint back on the inside and win the ball.

İlkay Gündoğan.title: The 12-Second Cup Final Volley
İlkay Gündoğan.event: Manchester City v Manchester United, FA Cup final
İlkay Gündoğan.lesson: Be switched on from the first second, and hit a falling ball with your laces on the volley.

Nico O'Reilly.title: Two Headers in the Cup Final
Nico O'Reilly.event: Arsenal v Manchester City, EFL Cup final
Nico O'Reilly.lesson: Full-backs can score too: arrive late in the box and attack the ball with your forehead.

Ronald Koeman.title: The Free Kick That Won the European Cup
Ronald Koeman.event: Barcelona v Sampdoria, European Cup final
Ronald Koeman.lesson: Strike through the middle of the ball with your laces for a powerful free kick.

Ricardo Quaresma.title: The Trivela v Iran
Ricardo Quaresma.lesson: Hit the ball with the outside of your foot to make it curve away from the keeper.

Bastian Schweinsteiger.title: The Warrior of the World Cup Final
Bastian Schweinsteiger.event: Germany v Argentina, World Cup final
Bastian Schweinsteiger.lesson: Stay goal-side, win the ball back and keep going, even when the game gets tough.

Wesley Sneijder.title: The Header That Beat Brazil
Wesley Sneijder.event: Netherlands v Brazil, World Cup quarter-final
Wesley Sneijder.lesson: At corners, even small players can score: find the space and attack the ball.

Ruud Gullit.title: The Captain’s Header in the Euro Final
Ruud Gullit.event: Netherlands v Soviet Union, Euro 1988 final
Ruud Gullit.lesson: Jump early, keep your eyes open and head the ball down towards the goal.

Ian Rush.title: Two Goals in the FA Cup Final Derby
Ian Rush.event: Liverpool v Everton, FA Cup final
Ian Rush.lesson: Time your run so you are onside, then take the ball round the keeper.

Peter Crouch.title: The Long-Range Volley v Man City
Peter Crouch.event: Stoke City v Manchester City, Premier League
Peter Crouch.lesson: Keep your eyes on the dropping ball and strike it cleanly before it bounces.

Freddie Ljungberg.title: The Curler in the FA Cup Final
Freddie Ljungberg.event: Arsenal v Chelsea, FA Cup final
Freddie Ljungberg.lesson: Run at the defender, then curl the ball into the far corner before they can block.

Robin van Persie.title: The Flying Header v Spain
Robin van Persie.lesson: Watch the long ball all the way and be brave: dive to meet it with your forehead.

Laurent Blanc.title: The First Golden Goal
Laurent Blanc.event: France v Paraguay, World Cup round of 16
Laurent Blanc.lesson: Defenders who join the attack late are hard to mark: be ready to finish first time.

James Rodríguez.title: The Puskás Volley v Uruguay
James Rodríguez.event: Colombia v Uruguay, World Cup round of 16
James Rodríguez.lesson: Cushion the ball on your chest, turn, and volley it before it touches the ground.

Filippo Inzaghi.title: Two Goals in the Champions League Final
Filippo Inzaghi.event: AC Milan v Liverpool, Champions League final
Filippo Inzaghi.lesson: Stay on the shoulder of the last defender and go the moment the pass is played.
